news: Oz Arena now runs on its own engine, with new lighting, 3D sound and these native menus.
Every world, fighter and weapon texture remade at four times the detail, and 35 arenas relit.
Rigged fighters with ragdolls, the remade effects and the Oz HUD, on every server you join.
The Server Browser lists every community server, vanilla, CPMA and Defrag, and joins in one click.
Build your own arenas, for Oz, CPMA and Defrag, and play them from the editor.
